svg.aria-label: Left: checkpoint after six Adam updates. Full recovery matches uninterrupted training; weights-only recovery keeps the same RNG but discards Adam state and diverges. Right: warmed-up data-operation timing. CSV and NPY read all 768 by 32 values; the cache operation copies only the current 96 rows, distinguishing full preparation from batch access.
